title: Shift compatibility of the compact-support projection and trace transpose
statement: Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Write $P_E=Rf_{!,E}$ and $G_E=Rf_E^!$ on the integral finite-Tor constructible categories, and let $T\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E)$ be arbitrary (no condition on the degrees in which $T$ is concentrated; for instance $T=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}(d)[2d]$ is allowed). For a morphism $t:P_ET\to\mathbf1_{E,Y}$ and $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, let $$\operatorname{PF}_{T,K}:P_ET\widehat\otimes^L K\xrightarrow{\sim}P_E(T\widehat\otimes^LLf_E^*K)$$ be the canonical compact-support projection map (including its tensor symmetries), an isomorphism on these inputs by [fix-prop-projection-formula], and define $$u_K=P_E(T\widehat\otimes^LLf_E^*K)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_{T,K}^{-1}}P_ET\widehat\otimes^LK\xrightarrow{t\widehat\otimes1}K.$$ The canonical projection comparison commutes with the cochain shift $K\mapsto K[1]$ in the second variable, with the canonical shift structures of $K\mapsto P_ET\widehat\otimes^LK$ and $K\mapsto P_E(T\widehat\otimes^LLf_E^*K)$, including the proper direct-image constituent and the open extension-by-zero constituent of compact support. The adjunction shift comparison $G_E(K[1])\xrightarrow{\sim}(G_EK)[1]$ is characterized by the counit shifted by one. If $\gamma_K: T\widehat\otimes^LLf_E^*K\to G_EK$ is the adjoint transpose of $u_K$, then under these canonical comparisons $$u_{K[1]}=u_K[1]\quad\text{and}\quad\gamma_{K[1]}=\gamma_K[1].$$ The finite-Tor category, projection map, extension by zero and integral compact support use [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-weil-triangulated-category], [def-exchange-projection], [fix-prop-projection-formula], [def-weil-extension-by-zero], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support] and [prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint].

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-adic-completed-projection-shift] to the chosen compactification and separately to the proper-only and open-only compactifications. Retain its actual completion and invertibility witnesses; the last two applications give the constituent squares.

Equip the actual exceptional adjunction with the right-adjoint shift induced from adicSupportShift. The Mathlib adjunction shift construction gives its counit equation. To prove uniqueness using only that equation, compare sigma tau^{-1}: after applying the left functor and composing with the shifted counit, the two counit equations make it the identity. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection proves sigma tau^{-1}=1.

The trace tensor square is [lem-pur-adic-trace-tensor-shift]. Precompose the proposed u square with the invertible shifted projection. Cancel its inverse on the left, substitute the projection square on the right, then cancel the shifted unshifted projection with its inverse. Functoriality of shift gives the desired trace square.

Apply [lem-pur-adic-exceptional-transpose-shift] to A₀=T completed-tensor Lf* K, A₁=T completed-tensor Lf* (K[1]), their canonical input comparison and the two trace maps u. The previous cancellation calculation supplies exactly its ambient square; its conclusion is the desired gamma square.
